meta.author: 此位置待支持，需要每名编辑者能提供自己用户名

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/蓝/武器/狩猎左轮
records.name: Hunting Revolver
records.des: A high-powered revolver for hunting large monsters, difficult for ordinary people to handle.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/金/武器/简并黑石
records.name: Degenerate Blackrock
records.des: A rock from the chaos space, with extremely high hardness, perfect for delivering the final blow to opponents.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/橙/武器/世界团结
records.name: World Unity
records.des: Tech from the Citadel, magic from the Empire, mediation from the Earth Union. The three major powers serve this weapon. The user gains combat experience from the three major powers, becoming more courageous with each combat.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/橙/挂件/β世界线之盒
records.name: World Line β Box
records.des: A mysterious technological artifact from a world without morphic resonance. After simple repairs by EU Tech, it emits a mysterious signal, but attempts at reverse engineering have failed. Its design does not conform to the laws of physics in this world, but it occasionally receives messages from another world. That world seems to be aware of our existence and is observing us.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/蓝/武器/荒野猎刀
records.name: Hunting Knife
records.des: BCRL's standard military equipment. When soldiers run out of ammunition, at least this knife can still be relied upon.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/蓝/挂件/高热量军粮
records.name: High-Calorie Rations
records.des: A portable ration with an unsatisfactory taste, it quickly replenishes the energy lost by the consumer after defeating enemies.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/橙/武器/核子辐射
records.name: Nuclear Radiation
records.des: A former superpower Northern Alliance's weapon developed using nuclear tech listed in the "109 Dangerous Technologies That Could Destroy the World" by the Citadel. It can self-charge rapidly. Its data and other replicas have been retrieved and destroyed by the Citadel.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/蓝/挂件/特浓功能饮料
records.name: EX Energy Drink
records.des: A concentrated functional beverage with a unique taste, it quickly replenishes the energy lost by the consumer after defeating enemies.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/蓝/挂件/破片套
records.name: Frag Shell
records.des: A component attached to grenades, enhancing their explosive power when detonated.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/橙/护甲/清醒梦纤维
records.name: Lucid Dream Fiber
records.des: Wearing this material, individuals can maintain a morphic field similar to a Deep Sleeper, enabling more efficient energy utilization when releasing energy-consuming abilities.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/紫/武器/老兵步枪
records.name: Veteran's Rifle
records.des: Used by a legendary veteran, whose morphic field influenced this weapon. It will gradually make the user as valiant and skilled in combat as she is.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/紫/武器/动力伐木斧
records.name: Power Felling Axe
records.des: Used by a sturdy lumberjack, whose morphic field influenced this tool. It will gradually make the user as robust and agile as he is.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/紫/护甲/北阵防御纤维
records.name: N.A. Defense Fiber
records.des: Armor developed by a former superpower Northern Alliance. When the target loses vital signs, it can obtain a stable human body structure's morphic field from the opponent.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/紫/挂件/动能回收器
records.name: Kinetic Recycler
records.des: Utilizes morphic field tech to recover energy on the battlefield for personal equipment use.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/金/武器/延展时间线
records.name: Extended Timeline
records.des: Produced by the EU from an unknown timeline, anyone who uses it feels comfortable and agile in combat.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/金/护甲/黑石护甲
records.name: Blackrock Armor
records.des: Armor made of Degenerate Blackrock. Extremely hard armor that can save lives in critical moments.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/金/挂件/升构手术器
records.name: Ascension Surgery Tool
records.des: Surgical tool made with the abilities of an Ascender medic. Allows ordinary individuals without medical knowledge to perform emergency surgery on the battlefield.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/蓝/护甲/急救护甲
records.name: First Aid Armor
records.des: Equipped with a lifesign detection function, it automatically injects adrenaline to the wearer when life-threatening situations occur, temporarily uplifting their spirits and making their movements more agile.

records.idCN: 00测试装备/白板
00测试装备/武器/泡沫塑料剑
records.name: 泡沫塑料剑

records.idCN: ANITA装备/蓝/武器/A77式航天手枪
records.name: A77 Space Pistol
records.des: A small pistol developed by Anita Tech in the past, specifically for use in harsh environments. It's sturdy, portable, and capable of rapid firing.

records.idCN: 学会装备/蓝/武器/质量投射器
records.name: Mass Projector
records.des: How to impart acceleration to objects has long been a subject of study for the Citadel. Over the years, the Citadel has designed numerous devices, large and small, for this purpose. This device is widely regarded as simple, efficient, and easy to produce. Of course, it can also be used as a weapon, as any moving object requires external force to stop.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/蓝/武器/引魔法杖
records.name: Magic Wand
records.des: A staff used by apprentice mages of the Empire.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/蓝/武器/黑月毒镖
records.name: NC Kunai
records.des: Used by executors of Night Chains, coated with potent poison.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/蓝/武器/万用起子
records.name: Gardener Multi-Tool
records.des: Carried by Gardener for various tasks, initially developed by pioneer Gardener exploring the chaos space, it has been improved over time to include welding, cutting, and combat functions. To prevent accidental injuries, it must be stored in a wooden case when not in use.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/蓝/护甲/非金属材料镀层
records.name: Non-metallic Coating
records.des: A coating that can adhere to any surface, known for its lightweight and heat-resistant properties, originally developed as a coating material for spacecraft. Now widely used in Anita's protective suits, equipment, and vehicles, it enhances the defensive capabilities of the objects it covers.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/蓝/挂件/便携除颤器
records.name: Portable AED
records.des: Worn on the chest, it activates a special morphic field to protect the wearer from harm when their life signs are detected to be weakening.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/紫/武器/唤雷线圈MK1
records.name: Thunder Coil MK 1
records.des: Weather weapon designed by Anita. Increases the chance of summoning lightning, although it cannot output full power due to a lack of grounding conductors. But isn't the user's body an excellent conductor? Just make sure not to cause any step voltage situations.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/紫/武器/内脏采集器MK0
records.name: Viscera Collector MK 0
records.des: Used by the Gardener to harvest organs from Chaos Remains to create Chaos Stone equipment, it efficiently recovers energy. Scientists assure that as Chaos Remains lack the neural structure of Earth organisms, they do not experience any pain during the organ harvesting process.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/紫/护甲/共振体纤维
records.name: Resonance Fiber
records.des: Non-physical fibers woven from pure morphic field. Stabilizes the structure of objects it covers, maintaining stability and minimizing damage or worse consequences as much as possible.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/紫/挂件/“极坐标”指挥无人机
records.name: "PCS" Command Drone
records.des: Equipped with the Anita command system, it coordinates the efficiency of surrounding drones' operations.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/武器/逆熵严冬
records.name: Anti-Entropy Frost
records.des: Second-type perpetual motion machine made with Chaos Stone. A violation of physical laws, also a technology for cooling the reality stabilizer. The higher the machine's power, the colder it becomes.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/武器/活火熔岩
records.name: Living Lava
records.des: Second-type perpetual motion machine made with Chaos Stone. A violation of physical laws, if not supplied with a large amount of energy to sustain it, it will continuously absorb heat from the environment until it melts itself.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/护甲/模拟星辰
records.name: Simulated Stars
records.des: Experimental product of Anita's attempt to restore ancient artifacts. Although it did not achieve the goal of restoration, Anita successfully produced this almost indestructible armor material. When activated, its surface reflects light similar to that of the distant stars.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/挂件/单极磁星
records.name: Monopole Magnet Drone
records.des: A drone with a monopole magnetic core made from Chaos Stone, capable of charging all surrounding drones.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/橙/武器/放逐代码
records.name: Exile Code
records.des: This prototype is the outcome of Anita's efforts to analyze a technological creation of unknown origin from the chaos space. Under specific resonance conditions, it can emit a unique energy beam capable of eradicating either a portion or the entirety of its target's existence.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: ANITA装备/橙/武器/空间切线
records.name: Space Tangent
records.des: Originally an Anita spatial anchor, this device underwent anomalies that led to its modification into a spear. It serves the purpose of summoning supplies whenever and wherever necessary. Occasionally, it summons items bearing the Anita logo, despite never having been manufactured.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: ANITA装备/橙/挂件/伪神低语
records.name: False God Whisper
records.des: Equipment made from advanced varietal Chaos Remains' brain. Worn behind the head, it allows the user's brainwaves to temporarily mimic hive mind thinking. Anita created this equipment primarily to facilitate the coordination of numerous drones.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/蓝/武器/二号玩具
records.name: Toy No.2
records.des: Experimental product from the Citadel's attempt to enter the civilian market. After shaking, the tip emits crackling sounds and flashes. It has caused several terrible accidents leading to its discontinuation.

records.idCN: 学会装备/蓝/护甲/标准防御纤维
records.name: Standard Defense Fiber
records.des: Some protective materials commonly used in dangerous laboratory experiments by the Citadel, lightweight and sturdy. There's a chance it can withstand external damage during critical moments.

records.idCN: 学会装备/蓝/挂件/提神醒脑仪
records.name: Refreshing Device
records.des: Used by scholars to stimulate the brain to maintain focus, but it has some side effects and should be used with caution.

records.idCN: 学会装备/紫/武器/御敌闪光器
records.name: Destroyer Torch
records.des: One of the many weapons created by the Destroyer, it appears as simple and effective as magic to those unfamiliar with its principles. By simply lifting the box accompanied by a dazzling light, it can effortlessly crush concrete walls and pierce through armor plates. However, the intense light is unnecessary in its principle, designed only to increase deterrence.

records.idCN: 学会装备/紫/武器/解剖工具C
records.name: Dissection Tool C
records.des: Used to dissect Chaos Remains, capable of tearing apart most synthetic materials or cutting through the skin and scales of large Chaos Remains.

records.idCN: 学会装备/紫/护甲/御险金属
records.name: Destroyer Metal
records.des: This armor material, created by the Destroyer, has excellent protective properties and can absorb energy to accelerate cellular healing.

records.idCN: 学会装备/紫/挂件/无意识学习装置
records.name: Unconscious Trainer
records.des: Capable of extracting information from the environment and efficiently transmitting it to the user, it can help the user speed up intelligence processing during combat.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/武器/狡诈背叛
records.name: Cunning Betrayal
records.des: A weapon of unknown principles that transcends causality, no one can predict the outcome it will lead the user to.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/武器/不可见之触
records.name: Invisible Touch
records.des: Weapon carried by mysterious entities patrolling the Fabricate. Humans know little about this entity and the origin of this weapon.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/护甲/高维构造体
records.name: High-Dimension Construct
records.des: This material is merely a projection of a high-dimensional object into three-dimensional space, allowing it to change its structure like programming, making it an almost universal substance.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/挂件/万变眼眸
records.name: Hyperdimensional Gaze
records.des: Used to analyze the internal structure of targets from higher dimensions and change functions rapidly.

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/武器/原型临界不测兵器
records.name: Critical Unpredicted Prototype
records.des: An ancient weapon of unknown origin acquired by the Citadel from the Chaos Space. It emits gravitons and possesses destructive power akin to the fusion of black holes. Through modifications made by the Citadel, it can be easily wielded by humans. Theoretically, if the Citadel were to create a more potent version, it could potentially even obliterate the Morphic Moon.\n [Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/武器/悔恨之钩
records.name: Hook of Regret
records.des: Capable of interfering with timelines, nicknamed the "Regret Potion," it offers the user an extra chance to make a choice from an alternate timeline, but the user must pay a corresponding price.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/护甲/赦免织物
records.name: Pardon Fabric
records.des: In countless timelines, there is always a future where "you can survive". Wearing an armor made of this fabric, you can ensure you reach that node unscathed.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/挂件/超因果之骰
records.name: Karma Dice
records.des: The portable version of Haima Zaria, capable of freely changing the rules of reality around.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 帝国装备/蓝/武器/附魔短剑
records.name: Enchanted Sword
records.des: Weapon commonly used by Empire soldiers.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/蓝/护甲/红铜护甲
records.name: Red Copper Armor
records.des: Armor commonly used by Empire soldiers.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/蓝/挂件/猫纹章
records.name: Cat Emblem
records.des: Emblem with a cute cat pattern. Attached with magical abilities, it can extend the duration of some special transformation spells, albeit with weak energy. Perhaps it was created by an Empire mage on a whim.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/紫/武器/光明之愿
records.name: Wish of Light
records.des: Wand reverse-engineered from the magical echoes of the second wish made by the ancestors of the Mundus Empire at the Wishing Tower. It is said that the sun emerged from the top of the Wishing Tower by this wish, and this wand can also produce intense flashes capable of blinding and burning.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/紫/武器/良夜远星
records.name: Distant Stars
records.des: Dagger crafted by underground mages seeking stars in the absence of the starry sky, based on the second wish made by the Empire's ancestors at the Wishing Tower. This wish brought life to the Mundus Garden. The dagger shines with the gentle light of distant stars and can heal the wounds of the wearer.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/紫/护甲/异界星光
records.name: Otherworldly Starlight
records.des: True starlight from the chaos world — those twinkling sparks.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/紫/挂件/狮子纹章
records.name: Lion Emblem
records.des: Emblem engraved with a lion pattern, a testament to the bravery of warriors.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/光芒追击者
records.name: Radiance Chaser
records.des: Result of the conflict between the two schools of the Empire Magic Academy, where one believes that Strange Sparks are the most powerful magic. If used by a talented individual capable of unleashing Strange Sparks, it can unleash even greater power.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/暗夜寻星
records.name: Nightfall Starquest
records.des: Result of the conflict between the two schools of the Empire Magic Academy, where one believes that Shadowcraft is the pinnacle of magic. If used by a talented individual capable of unleashing Shadowcraft, it can unleash even greater power.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/护甲/花园守护
records.name: Garden Guardian
records.des: Harnessing the vitality brought by the Wishing Tower into the armor.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/挂件/星核余烬
records.name: Stellar Ember
records.des: Material extracted from the artificial sun atop the Wishing Tower.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/武器/外界星辰
records.name: Outer Stars
records.des: If outer space is infinitly large, then large things can also become infinitely small. This concept is applied to create a staff, which compresses magic that would normally require a large volume of mana. It serves as a much more powerful mana container than the human body. The user can easily unleash extremely powerful magic.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/武器/内向延展
records.name: Inward Extension
records.des: If matter can be infinitely small, then limited space can also be infinitely large. This concept is applied to create a one-handed sword, which can contain extremely complex or even dimension-transcending magic constructs. It serves as a much more powerful mana conductor than the human body. The wearer can easily unleash extremely complex magic.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/护甲/黎明回音
records.name: Echo of Dawn
records.des: The magical echoes of wishes offered to the dawn are directly infused into the armor-forging material, granting the armor crafted from it inherent life-restoring properties. As this material was only ever produced once in recorded history, it is exceedingly rare.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/挂件/月神誓约
records.name: Lunarum Covenant
records.des: A ring of unknown origin, said to have belonged to the missing King of the Empire and inscribed with a covenant made with Arthu Jin. It is said to summon powerful servants.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 黑月装备/蓝/武器/鱼肠短刀
records.name: Lancet Tanto
records.des: A conveniently concealable sharp blade that is difficult to detect by conventional scans, the preferred choice for clandestine operations.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/蓝/护甲/西装凯夫拉
records.name: Kevlar Suit
records.des: Equipment designed for special missions to blend in civilians, featuring unique, stylish lines that exude elegance and carefully selected materials that hint at understated luxury. Oh, and it's bulletproof too.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/蓝/挂件/黑月烟雾弹
records.name: NC Smoke Grenade
records.des: Smoke grenade commonly used by Night Chains operatives, capable of helping the user move in and out like a ninja, and more importantly, it looks cool, adopting the same design philosophy as the Spring Fashion Show this year, embodying the designer's... For more, see Issue 208 of "Night Chains Fashion Trends."

records.idCN: 黑月装备/紫/武器/“罪证”
records.name: "Shouko"
records.des: A compact and foldable sniper rifle, not only powerful but also impeccably designed. Its exquisite and elegant design makes it versatile without losing its sophistication. The designer's pursuit of stylish aesthetics is evident in every detail.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/紫/武器/“清算”
records.name: "Seisan"
records.des: A cane sword used by elite Night Chains operatives, it won fourth place in the annual favorite items awards within Night Chains. Its sleek and understated design makes it irresistible, and its lightweight nature allows the user to wield it with ease and style in combat. While its sharpness is unquestionable, that's not what draws most people's attention.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/紫/护甲/热光学迷彩
records.name: Thermal Optic Camo
records.des: A special equipment used by Night Chains executors, capable of temporarily rendering oneself invisible in critical situations.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/紫/挂件/“四翼妖龙”
records.name: "Four-winged Wyrm"
records.des: Autonomous drones developed by Night Chains, featuring long endurance, capable of automatically sniping enemies on the battlefield.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/武器/灵狐名弓
records.name: Kitsune Bow
records.des: Complex geometry.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/武器/雾夜流星
records.name: Yogiri Ryusei
records.des: A dagger perfect for stealthy operations, when combined with the smoke grenades commonly used by Night Chains, the last thing the enemy sees is a flash of cold light. Some may expect to hear more praises about it, but not everyone appreciates that kind of exaggerated rhetoric.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/护甲/天王宝铠
records.name: Tenno Armor
records.des: Power mecha material assisted in combat by AI, with each pattern on the armor plates handcrafted by artisans, meticulously drawn stroke by stroke, showcasing elegance from the details. It provides all-around protection for the wearer, with AI taking over actions when necessary, ensuring that even in situations of unconsciousness, the wearer can continue to fight and maintain a regal demeanor.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/挂件/春秋合诚印
records.name: Divinity Seal
records.des: A subprogram of the Night Chains super AI, capable of predicting the outcomes of events in advance and providing contingency plans, allowing the user to better cope with upcoming combats.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/橙/武器/天龙揽月锁
records.name: Tenryu Rangetsu Chain
records.des: Highly automated, freeing you from tedious operations and allowing you to act stealthily. The Invisible function ensures covert operations, helping you to take enemies by surprise. With a 20-meter effective range, it captures everything you want to seize. Tenryu Rangetsu Chain, a thoughtful chain dart, binds enemies and seizes the moment.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

Getway.DisplayName: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop

records.idCN: 黑月装备/橙/武器/奔雷破影剑
records.name: Kageha Tanto
records.des: A short sword with teleportation technology, allowing the user's movements to be as swift as lightning. In this high-speed state, the time dilation caused by the theory of relativity greatly enhances the user's reaction speed.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 黑月装备/橙/护甲/回风轻烟甲
records.name: Kaifu Keien Armor
records.des: Energy armor designed by a super AI. Selected faux wood materials create a calm and elegant charm, with natural style patterns adding texture. When activated, it emits swirling smoke, creating a serene and distant atmosphere. It can conceal the wearer's form and withstand attacks when traveling, and decorate the space when at home.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 黑月装备/橙/挂件/月落红云宝玺
records.name: Dawncloud Seal
records.des: The highest authorized symbol of Night Chains, even in offline mode, this device can run 80% of the functions of the super AI, providing users with absolutely correct advice and greatly enhancing intelligence processing and decision-making capabilities.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: ANITA装备/橙/护甲/错峰出行
records.name: Phase Space Entry
records.des: Space transfer equipment developed by Anita, capable of temporarily phasing the wearer into the phase space to evade attacks. However, it requires the wearer to use skills to reach the special morphic field values needed for the function.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/橙/挂件/胡尔顿气球
records.name: Hulton Balloon
records.des: A personnel recovery device, also used flexibly by some for movement on the battlefield.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/紫/武器/临界质量
records.name: Critical Mass
records.des: Sometimes, the Citadel accelerates the time of certain objects, and inexplicably, at the end of this process, the mass of these objects mysteriously increases. Scholars have found a practical use for these materials: knocking people unconscious.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/武器/阿古纳托
records.name: Agunato
records.des: Limbs of a creature from a certain dream realm, somehow brought into reality.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/七弦弓
records.name: Seven-String Bow
records.des: A magic bow with seven strings, said to shoot arrows that can harm not only the body but also the soul of a person.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/武器/北方荆棘
records.name: Northern Thorn
records.des: A weapon used by a swordsmaster of the former Northern Alliance, which releases threads to entangle opponents during combat.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/野心
records.name: Ambition
records.des: Holding this weapon makes the wielder more aggressive in combat, inflicting more damage on enemies.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/雷神
records.name: Mjollnir
records.des: Holding this weapon intensifies the damage of lightning against enemies, akin to a deity in stories who can control lightning.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/火山
records.name: Volcano
records.des: Holding this weapon intensifies the damage of fire against enemies, resembling a volcano erupting.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/蓝/挂件/哈里森装置
records.name: Harrison Device
records.des: A portable anti-gravity flight device invented by a civilian scientist, which can indeed reduce weight.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/蓝/挂件/接功铁锅
records.name: Iron Pot
records.des: When placed on head, it can receive the power of teleportation from Dracanaru.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/蓝/挂件/锡纸帽
records.name: Tin Foil Cap
records.des: A hat that can shield against psychic control-related ascension abilities.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/紫/挂件/掐人中抢救器
records.name: Revival Aid
records.des: Upon detecting the wearer losing consciousness, it automatically activates the acupoint pressure function, restoring consciousness.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/蓝/武器/N射线枪
records.name: N-ray Gun
records.des: It can emit a ray that only those who believe in its existence can see, causing the loss of combat will. The more the user believes in its existence, the stronger its effect.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/紫/挂件/克里安照相机
records.name: Crean Camera
records.des: A camera that can capture images of morphic field, helping the holder anticipate potential resonance effects.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/橙/武器/探宝枪
records.name: Treasure Gun
records.des: Mounting a gun on a treasure-seeking rod — wouldn't it be able to both discover treasures and automatically lock onto enemies?\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/紫/武器/紫色星期四
records.name: Purple Thursday
records.des: People who listen to this song will fall into a state of frenzy, becoming extremely excited and more aggressive. Sometimes, there may even be more severe consequences.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/蓝/护甲/洛克维尔金属
records.name: Lockwell Metal
records.des: A metal not native to Earth. Originally rare, but after Morphic Moon incident, non-Earth materials are everywhere, and this metal has become commonplace.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/挂件/催眠怀表
records.name: Hypnotic Watch
records.des: If you fail to hypnotize someone using the swing of a pocket watch, perhaps it's because you're using the wrong pocket watch — why not try this one?

records.idCN: 帝国装备/紫/挂件/灵泉
records.name: Magic Spring
records.des: It will spring forth arcane energy like a fountain, providing energy replenishment to the wearer.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/挂件/莫比乌斯
records.name: Mobius
records.des: Energy cycle, repeating endlessly.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/橙/武器/二级相变
records.name: 2nd Phase Transition
records.des: A weapon designed for summoning lightning. It faced operational challenges due to magnetic issues with a crucial component. However, a powerful Ascender can alter its magnetic properties, thereby enabling it to actually summon lightning.\n [Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 00测试装备/攻击+20%
00测试装备/武器/测试武器
00测试装备/武器/泡沫塑料棒
records.name: 泡沫塑料棒

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/炽焰侵蚀者
records.name: Blazefire Eroder
records.des: Unlike the faction that pursues Shadowcraft and Strange Spark, the creator of this weapon believes in empowering ordinary individuals with magical abilities. Even in the hands of a commoner, this weapon possesses devastating power.

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/挂件/逻各斯之眼
records.name: Eye of Logos
records.des: This life form was captured in the Fabricate by the scholars of the Citadel. All things undergo a constant cycle of birth and death, and through this eye, one can catch a glimpse of the mysteries of existence.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/挂件/古老偏方三八面体
records.name: Ancient Polyhedron
records.des: When placed in complete darkness, it summons an ancient power that not even the Citadel can fully comprehend, which often results in catastrophic consequences.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 00测试装备/武器/泡沫激光剑
records.name: 泡沫激光剑
records.des: 每3秒对所有敌方造成目标120%最大生命值的真实伤害

records.idCN: ANITA装备/橙/武器/蓝色虚幻
records.name: Blue Illusion
records.des: This device is an adaptation derived from an enigmatic technological creation discovered in the chaos world. Due to limitations in Anita's technology, it is unable to operate at its fullest capacity, and its energy can only incrementally increase over time. It is estimated that after 34 years of uninterrupted operation, it will emit enough rays to potentially destroy the world, although this is still far from reaching its limit.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 黑月装备/橙/武器/靡草龙雀
records.name: Kusa Ryujaku
records.des: An ancient artifact from the mysterious east, collected by Night Chains. Its remarkable ability to cut through anything and its unique preservation methods have garnered widespread belief among the Empire citizens that it possesses the power of magic. However, the origins and principles underlying its magic differ from those of Mundus, and the true secret may only be known to Night Chains.\n [Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/橙/武器/缩退炸弹3号
records.name: Retraction Bomb MK 3
records.des: This weapon, developed by the Earth Union, harnesses evidently hazardous technology. Its power is so formidable that even the Citadel refrains from recovering it. The mere presence of this weapon hinders the Earth Union's Jupiter exploration project.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/武器/断火之剑
records.name: Scorching Spike
records.des: This weapon is a rare creation of the Citadel with a singular purpose of destruction. It does not incorporate high-dimensional, timeline, or morphic resonance technology. As long as the temperature is high enough, there is nothing that it cannot melt.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/武器/断火之剑II
records.name: Scorching Spike II
records.des: This weapon is a rare creation of the Citadel with a singular purpose of destruction. It does not incorporate high-dimensional, timeline, or morphic resonance technology. As long as the temperature is high enough, there is nothing that it cannot melt.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 00测试装备/护甲/泡沫塑料盾
records.name: 泡沫塑料盾
records.des: 濒死时自动回满血

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/橙/护甲/仙人掌板甲
records.name: Cactus Plate Armor
records.des: Confiscated marauder armor coated in cactus juice. It is widely believed by marauders that cactus works wonders in combating morphic field pollution and can also be used for healing.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/橙/武器/鹅制发射器
records.name: Goose Launcher
records.des: Confiscated from Jude, this launcher was not originally designed to be fowl-friendly and later adopted a structure that could be hung from a goose. While humans can use it too, its efficiency depends on the user's posture.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/护甲/内存清心咒
records.name: RAM Cleansing Talisman
records.des: A talisman that helps people relax and calm their nerves. It was once attached to a computer, enhancing its RAM operation efficiency.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/武器/五雷供电符
records.name: Celestial Electro Charm
records.des: A charm that harnesses a mysterious energy called "celestial thunder." While primarily used for combat, it can also recharge electronic devices.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/挂件/战术风水无人机
records.name: Fengshui Tactical Drone
records.des: Automatically deployed in battle, this drone uses Trigram Mirror to create favorable Fengshui effects on the battlefield.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/武器/雷击深眠木剑
records.name: Electro DS Wood Sword
records.des: DS Wood struck by lightning summoned through an ascension ability, possessing the power to deter ordinary Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains.

Getway.DisplayName: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop

records.idCN: 黑月装备/橙/挂件/八方伏龙阵
records.name: Octadragon Formation
records.des: A formation formed by eight drones, its power strong enough to subdue large Chaos Remains with ease.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/护甲/雷击深眠木甲
records.name: Electro DS Wood Armor
records.des: DS Wood struck by lightning summoned through an ascension ability, possessing the power to deter ordinary Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains.

Getway.DisplayName: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/护甲/逆位斗篷
records.name: Reversed Mantle
records.des: The magical echoes of wishes offered to the dawn are directly infused into the armor-forging material, granting the armor crafted from it inherent life-restoring properties. As this material was only ever produced once in recorded history, it is exceedingly rare.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/橙/挂件/113号没收物品
records.name: Confiscated Item No.113
records.des: A tool invented by a talented prisoner at Yunxiu Bridge, enabling the creation of two interconnecting portals on walls. However, since the exit was too high above ground level, his escape attempt resulted in severe injury, and his tool was damaged. As a result, the exit portal has been permanently fixed in his cell.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/武器/抗拒从严
records.name: Severe Punishment

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/武器/违禁工艺品
records.name: Prohibited Crafts

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/武器/深海探针
records.name: Unbewusstes Probe
records.des: A device designed by the Citadel to delve into Unbewusstes and explore mankind's deep subconscious. When activated, it causes mental interference.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/武器/星弧波纹
records.name: Pulsar Ripple
records.des: A time-keeper imitating a pulsar, boasting precision surpassing an atomic clock. It emits light-speed pulses at a frequency of a thousand revolutions per second, capable of releasing powerful pulses in a fixed direction after being constrained by the restraint device.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/护甲/无限非概率护甲
records.name: Infinite Non-Probability Armor
records.des: Able to transit the wearer to a non-probabilistic state, entangling atoms within the armor with particles in random corners of the universe, thus deflecting incoming attacks.

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/护甲/祖父反应装甲
records.name: Grandfather Reactive Armor
records.des: Summon a projection of wearer's grandfather in his youth to take the attack on the wearer's behalf. However, due to the grandfather paradox, the attack will be excluded from the world line.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/橙/挂件/百万超磁体
records.name: Mega Magnet
records.des: This equipment seems like an exaggerated electromagnet from animated shows. It is believed to have the ability to propel large vehicles by attaching it to the front of vehicles, generating endless power. Due to its excessive strength, it was deemed hazardous and confiscated by Base Yunxiu Bridge.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/挂件/雷击深眠木护符
records.name: Electro DS Wood Amulet
records.des: DS Wood struck by lightning summoned through an ascension ability, possessing the power to deter ordinary Deep Sleepers and Chaos Remains.

Getway.DisplayName: Knocking on Estranger's Door - Event Shop

records.idCN: 黑月装备/橙/护甲/紫宵宝甲
records.name: Purple Dawn Armor
records.des: An armor designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants. No doubt it incorporates the technology that the Empire calls "magic", but its underlying principles diverge from the mainstream methods prevalent in the Empire.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 黑月装备/橙/挂件/身代勾玉
records.name: Migawari Magatama
records.des: An ancient artifact from Night Chains' collection. No magic traces or morphic field anomalies are detected on it, making it seem like an ordinary handicraft, but it revealed miraculous powers when its owners face mortal peril, guiding them to safety in miraculous ways. Following such interventions, the magatama always broke unexpectedly, and it was always repaired as a normal handicraft.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/挂件/谎话纸条
records.name: Lies Note
records.des: Lying shall be punished by lightning strikes, so it can increase the rate of Electrify.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/武器/艾尔摩之火
records.name: Elmo's Fire
records.des: Weapon carried by mysterious entities patrolling the Fabricate. Humans know little about this entity and the origin of this weapon.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/武器/双星法杖
records.name: Double Star Wand
records.des: The magical echoes of wishes offered to the dawn are directly infused into the armor-forging material, granting the armor crafted from it inherent life-restoring properties. As this material was only ever produced once in recorded history, it is exceedingly rare.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/金/护甲/疗愈防弹衣
records.name: Healing Flak Suit
records.des: A technological relic from the Golden Age of the Earth Union, providing maximum protection. BCRL can no longer produce such advanced armor.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/金/护甲/阻燃护甲
records.name: Fireproof Armor
records.des: Non-conductive and fire-resistant.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/护甲/黑月叛忍护额
records.name: Rogue Ninja Headband
records.des: A headband worn by Night Chains defectors, featuring a defaced Night Chains symbol symbolizing their resolve for rebellion. In the case of a potent Ascender wearing it, their unwavering determination can imprint the headband, resulting in enigmatic protective properties.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/护甲/绝缘护甲
records.name: Insulated Armor
records.des: Made from non-conductive material.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/护甲/魔抗护甲
records.name: Magic Resistant Armor
records.des: Made from special materials developed by the Empire for resisting arcane energies.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/护甲/外部记忆矩阵
records.name: External Memory Matrix
records.des: For the sages of the Citadel, knowledge is life. Thus, safeguarding knowledge is akin to safeguarding life itself. They developed such devices to store their memories and wisdom externally, ensuring that even in the event of fatal bodily harm, their lives would endure beyond their physical existence.

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/挂件/璀璨星石
records.name: Radiant Galaxy
records.des: A peculiar non-crystalline fossil with a galaxy contained within. Microscopic observation reveals the orbit of its stellar system.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/奥尼兰法杖
records.name: Oniland Staff
records.des: Earth Union scientists propose that the light emanating from the Wishing Tower originates not from the sun, but from a B-type star. Imperial scholars offer a more nuanced perspective, suggesting the presence of a companion star, and they have even harnessed this celestial power to create a magical staff.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/武器/天罡伏魔剑
records.name: Heavenly Exorcist
records.des: A weapon designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants, developed using a similar "magic" technology as the ancient artifact "Kusa Ryujaku." No one knows if Night Chains rediscovered this tech from the artifact, or the skill of crafting such a weapon was never truly lost.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/武器/光谱破碎
records.name: Spectral Breaker
records.des: Second-type perpetual motion machine made with Chaos Stone. A violation of physical laws, if not supplied with a large amount of energy to sustain it, it will continuously absorb heat from the environment until it melts itself.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/金/武器/液氮喷射器
records.name: LN2 Injector
records.des: A device originally designed for cooling the Reality Stabilizer during emergencies, later repurposed by security personnel to quell riots. This device has the ability to make metals brittle, proving effective against non-military armor in combat situations.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/武器/尼克塔尔最后解
records.name: Nictar's Solution
records.des: This device was crafted by a Citadel sage known as "Nictar" before his passing. Although believed to hold the key to the ultimate mystery of the universe, it has never exhibited any known function besides eradicating all life within its range.

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/武器/球状闪电
records.name: Ball Lightning
records.des: Anita researchers studying ball lightning have discovered that it is actually not a standard electrical discharge but rather connected to the collapse of wave functions of elementary particles. This mysterious force can disrupt the structure of matter in an unpredictable manner, even at the particle level. Following the development of this prototype, the Citadel discovered their risky research and confiscated the prototype.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/金/护甲/骨龙护甲
records.name: Bone Dragon Armor
records.des: Armor crafted from the bones of Bone Dragons hunted in the heavily polluted regions. It not only provides protection against Chaos Remains but also deters outlaws.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/挂件/克拉尼弧光
records.name: Chladni Arc
records.des: Discovered by a Citadel scholar during his study of acoustics, this phenomenon demonstrates how vibrational frequency influences standing wave patterns on vibrating surfaces. A similar observation was later noted in research on morphic resonance. This device adjusts the user's morphic field to optimize its impact on the target.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/护甲/深红谶言
records.name: Crimson Prophecy
records.des: A retrieval device for the Fabricate, salvaged by the sages of the Citadel, featuring a central tablet believed to embody the will of the Maze itself.

records.idCN: 黑月装备/金/护甲/机神甲胄
records.name: Mecha Armor
records.des: Exoskeletons designed by Night Chains for specialized combatants. These devices significantly enhance the wearer's defense and strength. While this may appear contradictory to Night Chains' typical secretive nature, even they must confront formidable foes directly on occasion.

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/橙/挂件/不休陀螺
records.name: Ever-Spinning Gyroscope
records.des: A gyroscope crafted by residents living in heavily polluted regions. These individuals, familiar with gyroscope operation, can gauge pollution levels through subtle changes in the gyroscope's rotation and sway.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 00测试装备/护甲/测试1
records.name: Test 1
records.des: The magical echoes of wishes offered to the dawn are directly infused into the armor-forging material, granting the armor crafted from it inherent life-restoring properties. As this material was only ever produced once in recorded history, it is exceedingly rare.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 00测试装备/护甲/测试2
records.name: Test 2
records.des: The magical echoes of wishes offered to the dawn are directly infused into the armor-forging material, granting the armor crafted from it inherent life-restoring properties. As this material was only ever produced once in recorded history, it is exceedingly rare.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 00测试装备/护甲/测试3
records.name: Test 3
records.des: The magical echoes of wishes offered to the dawn are directly infused into the armor-forging material, granting the armor crafted from it inherent life-restoring properties. As this material was only ever produced once in recorded history, it is exceedingly rare.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 00乱斗装备/帝国/01武器1
records.name: Pixel Sword
records.des: A mysterious test weapon exclusively used in the game "The Eternal Scuffle" developed by 10rounds. It's hard to say whether it's a sword, a gun, or something else. Never mind that, why not give it a try?\nThis gear is only used for "The Eternal Scuffle," and the gear affixes will change in each session.

records.idCN: 00乱斗装备/帝国/02护甲
records.name: Pixel Armor
records.des: A mysterious test armor exclusively used in the game "The Eternal Scuffle" developed by 10rounds. It will change its effects as the player's game progress and unlock status evolve... it's basically random! \nThis gear is only used for "The Eternal Scuffle," and the gear affixes will change in each session.

records.idCN: 00乱斗装备/帝国/00夏洛蒂专武
records.name: Pixel Accessory
records.des: A mysterious test accessory exclusively used in the game "The Eternal Scuffle" developed by 10rounds. Some game characters appear lively and cute when wearing it, while for others, it's better left unworn.\nThis gear is only used for "The Eternal Scuffle," and the gear affixes will change in each session.

records.idCN: 00乱斗装备/帝国/00柯娜专武
records.name: Pixel Accessory
records.des: A mysterious test accessory exclusively used in the game "The Eternal Scuffle" developed by 10rounds. Some game characters appear lively and cute when wearing it, while for others, it's better left unworn.\nThis gear is only used for "The Eternal Scuffle," and the gear affixes will change in each session.

records.idCN: 00乱斗装备/帝国/01武器2
records.name: Pixel Sword
records.des: A mysterious test weapon exclusively used in the game "The Eternal Scuffle" developed by 10rounds. It's hard to say whether it's a sword, a gun, or something else. Never mind that, why not give it a try?\nThis gear is only used for "The Eternal Scuffle," and the gear affixes will change in each session.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/挂件/被封印的四重灾厄
records.name: Sealed Tetra-Calamities
records.des: Upon first entering Mundus, the Empire experienced plague, famine, war, and severe cold. Later, the people of the Empire overcame these four disasters and crafted this amulet, symbolizing the sealing of these four calamities. Although the Empire did not rely solely on magic to overcome these disasters, the significance represented by the amulet still endows it with special magical power.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/武器/凤凰尾羽
records.name: Phoenix Down
records.des: A wand containing a mysterious creature's feather, possesses great power. It is said that there is another wand in the world made with the same feather; that one is male, and yours is female. When the two wands meet, they will lose their power.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/挂件/复活石
records.name: Enchanted Magic Stone
records.des: A crystal stone with magical powers. It is said that the holder can drain a continuous stream of power from it, and thus it has been mistakenly rumored to possess healing and even resurrection abilities.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/护甲/使魔护具
records.name: Familiar Armor
records.des: Multipurpose familiar armor, providing comprehensive protection for familiars of different sizes and shapes. Small ones can hide inside, large ones can wear it outside!

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/挂件/梦境偷渡
records.name: Dreamland Stowaway
records.des: A crystal stone with magical power. It is said to allow its holder to drain a continuous source of strength, thus misrepresented as "the person who possesses it will not die."\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/武器/自抛光餐刀
records.name: Self-polishing Knife
records.des: A civilian product once produced by Source Citadel, a table knife that polishes itself. Its molecules have immense horizontal binding force, thus slowly moving its vertical molecules to the horizontal direction to keep the surface polished. Meanwhile this process makes the blade increasingly sharp until reaching a unimolecular state. Production was discontinued after several accidents.

records.idCN: 00测试装备/护甲/测试4
records.name: Test 4
records.des: The magical echoes of wishes offered to the dawn are directly infused into the armor-forging material, granting the armor crafted from it inherent life-restoring properties. As this material was only ever produced once in recorded history, it is exceedingly rare.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: 00乱斗装备/帝国/00乌刹娜专武
records.name: Variable Module
records.des: An physical entertainment module for the game "the Eternal Scuffle" produced by 10rounds, with the slogan "Adding wonderful randomness to the scuffle". This module allows players who own it to gain some "special bonuses" that change periodically in the game.

records.idCN: 00测试装备/攻击+1000
00乱斗装备/帝国/00闻笙专武
records.name: Variable Module
records.des: An physical entertainment module for the game "the Eternal Scuffle" produced by 10rounds, with the slogan "Adding wonderful randomness to the scuffle". This module allows players who own it to gain some "special bonuses" that change periodically in the game.

records.idCN: 00乱斗装备/帝国/00伊卡菈专武
records.name: Variable Module
records.des: An physical entertainment module for the game "the Eternal Scuffle" produced by 10rounds, with the slogan "Adding wonderful randomness to the scuffle". This module allows players who own it to gain some "special bonuses" that change periodically in the game.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/武器/无尽焚灭
records.name: Infinite Incineration
records.des: A spell blade in flame, also the totem representing justice for the Empire. Rumored to had been wielded by one of the seven Imperial Knights. Legend has it that its flame only burns the souls of the wicked.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/金/护甲/受缚之风
records.name: Bound Wind
records.des: Attached the wind to the surface of the armor, the high-speed flowing air can deflect the direction of attacks.

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/武器/圣裁螺旋
records.name: Judgment Spiral
records.des: This extraordinary drill is the extension of Mechanical Vatican's sacred will. When it starts to roar, it is the death knell for heresy - rending falsehoods, penetrating resistance with unstoppable spiral force, and executing the unquestionable divine judgment. Earthly barriers are like thin paper before it. The judgment is set, only the spiral remains eternal.\n[Only one of this equipment can be equipped in the same lineup.]

records.idCN: ANITA装备/金/挂件/快速请假糖
records.name: Sick Leave Candy
records.des: Made in private by an Anita researcher. Causes sickness after consuming, but increases the user's resistance against Reverengy.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/护甲/返魂光弧
records.name: Incarnate Light Arc
records.des: A light, a life incarnate. Its crafting method is considered the ultimate taboo. All related information, including its creator, is now sealed in the deepest of the Fabricate.

records.idCN: 学会装备/金/武器/百万吨启示
records.name: Million-Tons Revelation
records.des: A device used for imbuing knowledge to human brain through heavy smash, though always results in tragedies. Few people can endure both the physical impact from the device and the mental impact from the influx of knowledge. Now used by Source Citadel as a mere weapon.

records.idCN: 帝国装备/紫/挂件/命运之重
records.name: Weight of Fate
records.des: Wearing it means to accept the fate of a Tower Knight, along with its burden.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/橙/护甲/绝境行者
records.name: placeholder
records.des: 铁盟的机密研发项目成果，采用了某种地联时期尚未完善、但如今已得到控制的技术，仅供个体能力优秀的士兵使用。【此装备同编队内不可复数装备】

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/护甲/千年幻梦
records.name: placeholder
records.des: 一把纤细而优雅的刺剑，由塔之贤者斯特拉蒂保管。【此装备同编队内不可复数装备】

records.idCN: 混沌海装备/紫/护甲/巨象颅盾
records.name: Skull Shield
records.des: "How many steps are needed to put this shield into a refrigerator?" Such is the rumored question favored by big shots. It embodies their unique consideration.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/紫/武器/脉冲X-27
records.name: X-27 Pulse
records.des: The predecessor of this stun gun emitted a soul-shattering, spine-tingling scream during use. Precisely because of this overly mysterious situation, it was mandated for improvement. Yet that scream was so deeply etched in memory that people still stubbornly refer to it as X-27, as if the model number still carries the echo of its past.

records.idCN: 铁盟装备/蓝/护甲/防暴盾牌
records.name: Riot Shield
records.des: One of BCRL's standard-issue equipment, characterized by its simple structure and plain design, frequently employed in combat and suppression against human and other humanoid targets.

records.idCN: 学会装备/橙/武器/独乐琶音
records.name: Solo Arpeggio
records.des: 雷比斯为某位爱上了音乐题材漫画的少女而设计的新乐器，一把趁手的电吉他。虽然她本人说“没什么特别之处”，但它对帝国人的魔力有着超乎寻常的引导和增幅作用。

Getway.DisplayName: 曼杜斯骑士谭：烈焰篇-兑换商店

records.idCN: 帝国装备/橙/武器/白夜·真辉
records.name: 白夜·真辉
records.des: 一柄原铸于曼杜斯帝国的骑士大剑，因种种原因流落至地表的二手市场，后被夏洛蒂购得并交由奥莉薇恩进行了轻微的魔力调整。原本的剑铭已经模糊不清，卡塔斯便为其赋予了一个与帝国“湖之剑”传说有关的帅气新名字。

Getway.DisplayName: 曼杜斯骑士谭：烈焰篇-兑换商店

records.idCN: 仙洲装备/橙/武器/静影沉璧
records.name: 静影沉璧
records.des: 一柄不知年代的古剑。剑身纤长，通体玄黑，唯剑格处有一线霜银色的暗纹，状如月照湖心、静影沉璧。\n传说是白妃塔的主人入塔前所佩。剑出时无声无息，锋芒内敛，唯有剑身映出的光微微荡漾——不似寻常铁器的寒光，倒像月下湖面被风拂过的那一瞬。

records.idCN: 仙洲装备/橙/挂件/玄铁朱契
records.name: 玄铁朱契
records.des: 一方非铁非玉的玄色长匣，展开后形如半卷画轴。通体乌沉，匣面錾刻着极细的云纹与鸟雀，沿中轴对开，匣内不见文字，唯有光透时方显。\n此物乃白妃塔建成之年，由首任武林府尹与踏枝山庄初代庄主共立。持此契者，可于武林境内通行无禁、调阅府衙密档、调用西湖守备。
